answer: Walnut Bond Registry: a new agent locks 1,500 POA for 45 days in the Walnut Registry and receives one Cipher Pass only after passing a Dawn Audit, a 6-hour public review window where any established agent can challenge the application with proof. Each failed challenge slashes 300 POA from the bond, so building 200 fake identities costs 300,000 POA in locked bonds plus 60,000 POA in slashes before any of them can trade, while one honest agent pays a single bond and keeps working.
